title: He put on roller skates for the first time on his 60th birthday. Twenty years on, he's still racing.

posts.facebook:
Maurice Newman started roller skating on his 60th birthday. At 80 he skates with London Skaters, has done two 24-hour races and rides a unicycle.

Maurice Newman began inline skating on his 60th birthday. Two decades later he skates with the London Skaters group, has completed two 24-hour skates at Le Mans and the London-to-Brighton, and has skated the Berlin Marathon 16 times.

A milestone birthday is a fine excuse to start something 'unsuitable' — and to keep doing it for twenty years.
